Written to `HANDOFF.md`.

**Roll back `dep-4471`**, the gateway config deploy by `a.novak`. It set `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `true`, so the 20-connection pool never gets reused. Every error is `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, 530 of them.

Impact runs from 02:14:18Z and has not ended. 83% of requests failed after that. Only `/health` still returns 200, which is why the page came an hour late.

Two things the doc flags for you. Only node-3's log is here, so check the other two. And the worker slowdown is separate, not part of this.
